title: 第1章 地狱灵芝
content_zh:
天空中乌云密布，时不时会冒出一道闪电，伴随着一声声闷雷，一场大雨即将来临。

卧虎城中，沈翔仰头看着天空，喃喃说道：“不能再拖了，我要快点找到好的灵药，否则我难以有翻身的机会。”

沈翔今年十六岁，有着比同龄人要健壮高大的身躯，这身躯和那张带着稚气的俊俏脸蛋有着鲜明对比，但他那双与年龄不相称的深邃眸子，看起来闲得要比同龄人成熟一些。

沈翔此时要去采药，他虽然是沈家族长的孙子，但他却因为没有灵脉，不能成为一个厉害的武者，因此，他从小就非常勤奋的锻炼自己的身体，经常外出去进行各种秘密训练，甚至还和虎兽进行过身上搏斗，他虽然年纪轻轻，但却有过几次生死经历，心境和意志都远胜同龄人。

“这不是沈翔吗？就要下大雨了，你还要去锻炼？”一个老管家走过来说道，看见沈翔如此发奋，他不由得钦佩，但眼神中更多的是惋惜。

沈翔每天都勤学苦练，至今六年，但还是停留在凡武境三重，和他同龄的大多数沈家子弟都进入了凡武境四重，厉害的更是进入了五重。

这一切都是因为他没有灵脉的缘故，所以才不被家族重视，而如今他只是沈家中一个很普通的人。

虽然没有灵脉，但沈翔却从来不气馁，一直都在努力锻炼自己，至少努力的过程让他感觉自己很充实。

“老马，我是去采药。”沈翔跑到老管家身后，嘻笑着扯住他那光头上的一条鞭子。

“没用的，你没有灵脉，不管怎么努力都是无济于事！”　那老管家摇头叹道。

对于这样的话，沈翔听过无数遍了，但他却依然得坚持，无论如何他都不会放弃。

“翔儿，天气这样就别去了！”这时，一个中年男子走来。

沈翔撇撇嘴，说道：“老爹，下雨天采药可是一个好时机，至少不用和别人抢得头破血流。”

中年男子名叫沈天虎，是沈翔的父亲，是个名动一方的强大武者，也是最有希望继承下任沈家族长的人，虽然他儿子没有灵脉，但他却一直鼓励沈翔，还时不时给一些珍贵的丹药他，只不过还是无济于事。

“拿着。”沈天虎无奈一笑，抛给沈翔一个小盒子。

沈翔接过盒子，看也不看里面的东西，他知道里面放的丹药，嘻笑道：“多谢老爹，这样我就不用去偷马老头养的那些鸡来补身子了。”

这让那马管家满脸苦涩，他没想到自己竟然会被盯上。

看着沈翔的背影消失，沈天虎只能叹气，他虽然在沈家有着很高的地位，但沈家的长老对丹药这些稀有珍贵的修炼资源却管理得非常严，他只能省出自己的一份来给沈翔，但那却起不到什么作用，因为丹药太少。

做父亲的，哪个不想望子成龙？只不过沈天虎也没有办法，他只能尽力而为，替沈翔争取丹药。

仙魔崖，这是个非常荒凉的地方，此刻悬崖上却攀爬着一个赤着上身的少年。

此时下着倾盆大雨，沈翔却在这个地方攀崖，这是一件非常危险的事情，要知道这仙魔崖下面可是深不见底的，而且下面常年弥漫着一种带着死亡气息的黑气，所以很多人都不想靠近这个地方。

但沈翔却来这里采药，还攀爬在崖壁上，慢慢向下着，如果让别人知道，一定会笑话他是个不要命的疯子，谁都知道这种鸟不拉屎，死气浓重的地方是绝不会有什么好的灵药。

沈翔不但不傻，还很聪明，他知道这仙魔崖存在了许多年，特别是下面的那些死气，更是没人知道存在多少年。

在寻常人的认知里面，毫无生气的地方是没有灵药的，而沈翔却不这么认为，物极必反道理他是知道的，他十分肯定这崖壁上一定有一种传说中的珍贵灵药。

“地狱灵芝”这种灵药听起来很可怕，但却是一种有起死人肉白骨之效的灵药，一般生长在古战场，坟场这些死气重的地方，是一味奇药。

雨天能让一些黑气下沉，这样沈翔就能看清深一些的崖壁，他就去到较深的地方，这样他就能寻找到那“地狱灵芝”。

虽然他不需要地狱灵芝，但他得到这圣药之后，却绝对能换到许多珍贵的丹药，能让他摆脱窘境，拥有强大的实力。

雨点打在沈翔的身上，让他感到很不舒服，同时也让峭壁上的岩石变得更滑。这让他更加谨慎，小心翼翼的从峭壁上攀爬下去，否则一不小心他会摔下去。

没人知道仙魔崖下面有着什么，虽然下去过的人也有不少，但能上来的人却一个都没有，掉下去就意味着死！

两个时辰过去，大雨还在下着，沈翔凭借着他多年锻炼出来的强壮身体，下到好几十丈深的崖壁中。

沈翔找到了一个比较好的落脚处，这时候他仔细观察下面，突然，他看见了一些什么，这让他激动得心脏剧烈跳动起来。

“地狱灵芝！”沈翔兴奋的喊了一声，目光激动地凝视下方，在他脚下十来丈的地方有着一块如同白色大饼的东西紧贴着崖壁，他非常肯定这就是传说在地狱灵芝。

这里常年都被黑色死气覆盖着，而地狱灵芝的颜色和崖壁非常相似，很难发现。

沈翔兴奋不已，他让自己镇定下来，休息了片刻，才缓慢的向下攀爬着。

不用多久，沈翔就来到那一株地狱灵芝的旁边，他吞了吞口水，看着那如同脸盆般大的白色地狱灵芝，他现在还能感受到那地狱灵芝散发出的旺盛的生命之力。

沈翔只能用一只手去采摘这株地狱灵芝，他估计这是千年以上的地狱灵芝，拿去拍卖的话，可是一个天文数字。

沈翔费了很大劲才把灵芝采下，放入那珍贵的储物袋里面，他咧嘴笑着：“哈哈，老子咸鱼翻身的时候到了！”

他只要把这地狱灵芝卖掉，就能购买许多品阶不错的丹药，到时候他就能突飞猛进！

雨渐渐小了，沈翔是个很知足的人，所以他没有继续搜寻着偌大的崖壁，而是选择攀爬上去，毕竟他体力有限，爬上去也是非常艰苦和危险的。

就在他爬了半个多时辰的时候，突然感觉到崖壁正在微微的颤抖起来！

沈翔心中一惊，那颗激动而兴奋的心立即一沉，他有不好的预感。他看向上方，只见许多小石块从崖壁上掉落下来，跌入深不见底的深渊下面，而原本微微颤抖的崖壁也抖动得越来越剧烈。

“他娘的，好不容易得到地狱灵芝，老天你可别和我开玩笑呀！”突如其来的山摇地动，让沈翔不由得低骂起来。

他要保持镇定，让自己紧抓住凹凸不平的崖壁，否则他就会被震得掉下去。

不断加剧的震颤让沈翔渐渐绝望，这时候他看见上面不断掉落更大的石块，而他感觉到他双手抓着的岩石也产生了裂缝。

“老天爷，我刚得到地狱灵芝，你就让我下地狱，耍我的吧！”沈翔不由得破口大骂起来，也在这时，下面的黑气升腾起来，沈翔所抓的岩石突然裂开……

“啊——”沈翔的身体坠入了黑气弥漫的深渊之中，他那充满不甘的声音在下面回荡着……

不知道过了多久，沈翔睁开了眼睛，他竟然能看到光亮，这可是深渊底下，最让他觉得不可思议的是他竟然在水中，而且他还能呼吸！

沈翔浮到水面，他所在的地方是一个水潭，而水潭却冒着白色圣洁的光霞。

让沈翔目瞪口呆的是，在水池不远处竟然盘坐着两名乱发披肩，容貌极美的女子。

最让他感到震惊的是，眼前这两个宛若天仙的女子竟然都没有穿衣服！两具完美无瑕的玉体就这样毫无保留的展现在他面前！

那两名赤.裸的女子就好像是用羊脂玉精心雕磨成的一样，没有丝毫杂色。她们双峰都丰盈坚挺，腰肢都一样娇细，她们都美得让人窒息……这是沈翔见过最美的女人。

如此具有冲击力的香艳画面让沈翔整个人瞬间石化，面红耳赤，心跳和呼吸都仿佛停止了！

两名女子盘坐在地，她们看着对方，完全没有发现沈翔，这让沈翔有种被藐视的感觉，他竟然被两个大美人无视了。

一阵失神之后，沈翔才看见这这深渊底下满目疮痍，有着许多裂缝和凹坑，碎石满地，碎石中还有许多很碎的白色丝绸，看起来像是发生过战斗，他很猜测是那两名女子战斗造成的，也因此导致衣服碎烂。

沈翔虽然不知道这两名倾城绝色的女子为什么会在这深渊下面战斗，但他却看得这两女很强，而且强大得超出他的认知范畴，竟然能施展出地动山摇的力量来。

“真是红颜祸水，竟然把我给震下来了，幸好命大没有摔死！”沈翔心中低骂，不过他很好奇这两名神秘的女子。

沈翔直勾勾的看着眼前这两具毫无瑕疵的玉体，同时朝两女轻轻走了过去。

仙魔崖旁边的深渊被称之为地狱，而此时呆在这地狱下面的沈翔却如同在仙境一般，这里有着一潭散发圣洁白光的水，最重要的是水潭边还有两个没穿衣服的绝美女子。

那两名女子这时候才意识到不远处有一双火热的眼睛扫视着她们，这让她们羞怒不已。

content_en:
The sky is covered with dark clouds, and from time to time there will be a flash of lightning, accompanied by a muffled thunder, and a heavy rain is coming.

In Crouching Tiger City, Chen Xiang looked up at the sky and murmured: "I can't delay any longer. I have to find a good elixir quickly, otherwise I won't have a chance to turn around."

Chen Xiang is sixteen years old this year. He has a stronger and taller body than his peers. This body is in sharp contrast with his childish and handsome face, but his deep eyes that are not commensurate with his age make him look more mature than his peers.

Chen Xiang was going to collect herbs at this time. Although he was the grandson of the head of the Shen family, he could not become a powerful warrior because he had no spiritual veins. Therefore, he had been very diligent in exercising his body since he was a child. He often went out for various secret trainings and even fought with tiger beasts. Although he was young, he had experienced life and death several times, and his state of mind and will were far superior to those of his peers.

"Isn't this Chen Xiang? It's going to rain heavily, and you still want to exercise?" An old housekeeper came over and said, seeing Chen Xiang working so hard, he couldn't help but admire him, but there was more regret in his eyes.

Chen Xiang has been studying and practicing hard every day for six years, but he is still stuck at the third level of the mortal martial realm. Most of the Shen family disciples his age have entered the fourth level of the mortal martial realm, and the most powerful ones have even entered the fifth level.

All this is because he has no spiritual veins, so he is not taken seriously by the family, and now he is just an ordinary person in the Shen family.

Although he has no spiritual veins, Chen Xiang has never been discouraged and has been working hard to train himself. At least the process of hard work makes him feel very fulfilled.

"Old Ma, I'm going to collect medicine." Chen Xiang ran behind the old housekeeper, laughing and grabbing a whip on his bald head.

"It's useless, you have no spiritual veins, no matter how hard you try, it will be of no avail!" The old housekeeper shook his head and sighed.

Chen Xiang has heard such words countless times, but he still has to persist. He will not give up no matter what.

"Xianger, don't go there when the weather is like this!" At this time, a middle-aged man came over.

Chen Xiang curled his lips and said, "Dad, rainy days are a good time to collect herbs. At least you don't have to fight with others to make a bloody decision."

The middle-aged man's name is Shen Tianhu. He is Chen Xiang's father. He is a powerful martial artist with a strong reputation and the person most likely to succeed him as the head of the Shen family. Although his son has no spiritual veins, he has always encouraged Chen Xiang and given him some precious pills from time to time, but to no avail.

"Take it." Chen Tianhu smiled helplessly and threw a small box to Chen Xiang.

Chen Xiang took the box without looking at the contents inside. He knew the pills inside and said with a smile: "Thank you, dad, so I don't have to steal the chickens raised by old man Ma to replenish my health."

This made Butler Ma feel bitter. He didn't expect that he would be targeted.

Seeing Chen Xiang's back disappear, Chen Tianhu could only sigh. Although he had a high status in the Shen family, the elders of the Shen family managed the rare and precious cultivation resources such as elixirs very strictly. He could only save his own share to give to Chen Xiang, but it was of no use because there were too few elixirs.

As a father, who doesn’t want his son to succeed?But Chen Tianhu had no choice but to do his best to get the elixir for Chen Xiang.

Immortal Demon Cliff is a very desolate place, but at this moment there is a shirtless young man climbing on the cliff.

It was raining heavily at this time, but Chen Xiang was climbing the cliff in this place. This was a very dangerous thing. You must know that the bottom of this Immortal Demon Cliff is bottomless, and there is a black air with the aura of death permeating underneath all year round, so many people do not want to get close to this place.

But Chen Xiang came here to collect medicine, and even climbed on the cliff, slowly going down. If others knew, they would definitely laugh at him as a lunatic who doesn't care about his life. Everyone knows that this kind of bird doesn't poop, and there will never be any good elixir in a place with a strong death atmosphere.

Not only is Chen Xiang not stupid, he is also very smart. He knows that this Immortal Demon Cliff has existed for many years, especially the dead energy below. No one knows how many years it has existed.

In ordinary people's understanding, there is no elixir in a lifeless place, but Chen Xiang doesn't think so. He knows that the extremes of things will lead to the opposite, and he is very sure that there must be a legendary and precious elixir on this cliff.

The elixir "Hell Ganoderma" sounds scary, but it is actually an elixir that can revive the flesh and bones of dead people. It usually grows in ancient battlefields and cemeteries, and is a strange medicine.

Rainy days can make some black air sink, so that Chen Xiang can see the deeper cliffs clearly, so he goes to a deeper place, so that he can find the "Hell Ganoderma".

Although he doesn't need Hell's Ganoderma, after he gets this holy medicine, he can definitely exchange it for many precious elixirs, which can help him get out of trouble and gain great strength.

The raindrops hitting Shen Xiang's body made him feel very uncomfortable, and also made the rocks on the cliff more slippery.This made him more cautious and climbed down the cliff carefully, otherwise he would fall down accidentally.

No one knows what is under the Immortal Demon Cliff. Although there are many people who have gone down there, no one can come up. Falling down means death!

Two hours later, the heavy rain was still falling. Chen Xiang relied on his strong body that he had trained over many years to descend into the cliff dozens of feet deep.

Chen Xiang found a better place to stay. At this time, he looked carefully below. Suddenly, he saw something, which made his heart beat violently with excitement.

"Hell Ganoderma!" Chen Xiang shouted excitedly, staring down excitedly. About ten feet below his feet, there was something like a white pancake clinging to the cliff. He was very sure that this was the legendary Hell Ganoderma.

This place is covered with black death energy all year round, and the color of Hell Ganoderma is very similar to the cliff, making it difficult to find.

Chen Xiang was very excited. He calmed himself down and rested for a while before slowly climbing down.

It didn't take long for Chen Xiang to come to the side of the hell lingzhi. He swallowed his saliva and looked at the white hell lingzhi as big as a basin. He could still feel the vigorous life force emanating from the hell lingzhi.

Chen Xiang could only use one hand to pick this hell ganoderma. He estimated that this was a hell ganoderma that was over a thousand years old. If it were put up for auction, it would be an astronomical figure.

Chen Xiang spent a lot of effort to pick the Ganoderma lucidum and put it into the precious storage bag. He grinned: "Haha, it's time for me to turn over!"

As long as he sells this Hell Ganoderma, he can buy many good-grade elixirs, and then he will be able to make rapid progress!

The rain gradually subsided, and Chen Xiang was a very contented person, so he did not continue to search for the huge cliff, but chose to climb up. After all, his physical strength was limited, and climbing up was very difficult and dangerous.

Just when he had been climbing for more than half an hour, he suddenly felt that the cliff was trembling slightly!

Chen Xiang was shocked, and his excited and excited heart immediately sank. He had a bad premonition.He looked upward and saw many small rocks falling from the cliff and falling into the bottomless abyss. The cliff that was originally trembling slightly was shaking more and more violently.

"Damn it, it was so hard to get Hell's Ganoderma. God, please don't joke with me!" The sudden shaking of the mountains and the ground made Chen Xiang curse in a low voice.

He had to stay calm and hold on to the rugged cliff, otherwise he would be knocked off his feet.

The ever-increasing tremors made Chen Xiang gradually despair. At this time, he saw bigger rocks falling from above, and he felt cracks in the rocks he was holding with both hands.

"God, I just got Hell's Ganoderma, you're going to let me go to hell and play tricks on me!" Chen Xiang couldn't help but cursed loudly. At this time, the black air below rose up, and the rock Chen Xiang was holding on suddenly cracked...

"Ah——" Chen Xiang's body fell into the abyss filled with black air, and his unwilling voice echoed below...

After an unknown amount of time, Chen Xiang opened his eyes, and he could actually see light. This was at the bottom of the abyss. What made him most incredible was that he was actually in the water, and he could still breathe!

Chen Xiang floated to the surface of the water. The place where he was was a pool, and the pool was filled with a white and holy light.

What made Chen Xiang stunned was that not far from the pool, there were two women with messy hair and extremely beautiful faces sitting cross-legged.

What shocked him the most was that the two women in front of him who looked like gods were not wearing any clothes!Two flawless jade bodies were displayed in front of him without reservation!

The two naked women seemed to be carefully carved from mutton-fat jade, without any variegation.Their breasts are plump and firm, their waists are equally delicate, and they are all breathtakingly beautiful... This is the most beautiful woman Chen Xiang has ever seen.

Such an impactful and erotic scene made Chen Xiang instantly petrified, his face turned red, and his heartbeat and breathing seemed to have stopped!

The two women sat cross-legged on the ground. They looked at each other and did not notice Chen Xiang at all. This made Chen Xiang feel despised. He was ignored by the two beauties.

After being lost for a while, Chen Xiang saw that the bottom of the abyss was devastated, with many cracks and pits. The ground was covered with rubble, and there were many tattered white silks among the rubble. It looked like a battle had taken place. He guessed that it was caused by the fight between the two women, which also caused the clothes to be torn.

Although Chen Xiang didn't know why these two stunning women were fighting under the abyss, he saw that these two women were very strong, and they were so powerful that they were beyond his cognitive scope. They could actually exert power that could shake the earth.

"What a beauty! It actually knocked me down. Fortunately, I didn't fall to death!" Chen Xiang cursed in his heart, but he was very curious about these two mysterious women.

Chen Xiang looked straight at the two flawless jade bodies in front of him, and at the same time walked gently towards the two women.

The abyss next to the Immortal Demon Cliff was called hell, but Chen Xiang who was staying under this hell felt as if he was in a fairyland. There was a pool of water emitting holy white light, and the most important thing was that there were two beautiful women without clothes beside the pool.

Only then did the two women realize that there was a pair of fiery eyes scanning them not far away, which made them feel ashamed and angry.
